definitions.explanation: The act or state of eating more than is good for one's health or comfort. Used both for a single occasion (eating too much at one meal) and a habitual pattern.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎでお{腹|なか}が{痛|いた}い。
{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎに{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please be careful not to overeat.

examples.japanese: {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}は{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎと{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎで{体重|たいじゅう}が{増|ふ}えてしまった。
examples.english: Over the New Year holidays, I gained weight from overeating and drinking too much.

notes:
Noun form of {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎる (to overeat), formed with the ます-stem + {過|す}ぎ. The same pattern works with many other verbs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎに{注意|ちゅうい}する: to watch out for overeating
- {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎで{太|ふと}る: to put on weight from overeating
- {食|た}べ{過|す}ぎと{飲|の}み{過|す}ぎ: overeating and overdrinking

SIMILAR PATTERN:
- {飲|の}み{過|す}ぎ: drinking too much
- {寝|ね}{過|す}ぎ: oversleeping
- {使|つか}い{過|す}ぎ: overuse
- {働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎ: overwork
